title: Stage area context menu on right-click
description:
Add a right-click context menu to the stage area in packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx.

The stage canvas (lines 4110-4182) has no onContextMenu handler. Add one that shows a popup with context-sensitive items:

When objects are selected:
- Cut (Cmd+X)
- Copy (Cmd+C)  
- Paste in Place (Cmd+Shift+V)
- Delete
- Select All (Cmd+A)
- separator
- Group (Cmd+G) — only if multiple objects selected
- Ungroup (Cmd+Shift+G) — only if a group is selected
- Convert to Symbol...
- separator
- Arrange submenu: Bring to Front, Bring Forward, Send Backward, Send to Back
- separator
- Properties...

When nothing is selected:
- Select All
- Paste (if clipboard has content)
- separator
- Insert Frame (F5)
- Insert Keyframe (F6)

Implementation approach: Look at how the Timeline ContextMenuPopup works (Timeline.tsx:2307) and follow the same pattern. The context menu should be a floating div positioned at the mouse cursor coordinates, dismissible by clicking outside (same pattern as timeline context menu). Wire to existing Shell.tsx handlers: onCut, onCopy, onPaste, onSelectAll, onGroup, onUngroup, onDeleteSelected, onConvertToSymbol, onArrange.
